[2026-09-13T16:28:08+00:00] SHIPPED fcc81090a — HIS FOURTH ROUND: 'You nailed everyone except the 3 I posted.' Three stacks where the cross sat on the LIT COURSE just under the opening, and a fourth (chimney_024's crown, south-west) where it sat on the rim above it. Measured against his four hand marks after the fix: 1.0, 1.1, 1.7, 2.2 px. Four rules, each a trap any future measurement on a sprite will hit: (1) A GROW CAN WALK OUT OF THE HOLE — a cap's rim casts a dark band wall to wall under the mouth that joins it through one shadowed mortar joint, and the mean of mouth+band lands on the band; a mouth is never as wide as the stack, so a grown shape that is gets dropped and the darkest core alone is the hole. (2) THE MIDDLE IS THE BOX CENTRE, NOT THE MEAN, and it is SNAPPED onto a pixel really in the region — a mouth carries a ragged dark fringe down its shaded side and the mean rides into it (5 px off his mark on chimney_009 where the box centre landed 1 px away). (3) A DARK CAP NEEDS A DARKER CUT — a wooden crown is as dark as its own cavity, so the two fuse, touch the outline and are dropped; the cut now walks a ladder until the cavity separates, first rung that finds anything wins, so pieces that already worked are untouched. (4) THE OUTLINE IS THE OUTSIDE, NOT ANY TRANSPARENT PIXEL — a cap raised on legs has real holes through it and the mouth touches them; the transparent pixels are flood-filled from the canvas edge and only that background disqualifies a blob. Two more from the same round: inside a POT the highest dark thing is the mouth (the size slack that lets a cap's far rim win was handing the anchor to the pot's shaded flank), and a flue is told from a three-quarter box corner by a PLATEAU (a pot repeats one width down its body, a corner repeats nothing) — the ratio and step-out tests are gone, a pot tapers 2.6x and in three-quarter the cap under it starts at its own corner. Final: 117 `opening`, 3 `flue_top`, 0 silhouette fallbacks over 120, every anchor on a dark pixel of its own art. AND THE CHEAP HALF OF THE LESSON IS NOW A GATE: vent.py --check re-reads every published anchor and fails any that is off the art or on lit material (`OFF THE HOLE`) — it flags three of these four. It cannot replace looking, which is what caught all four rounds, but it means the same class cannot ship silently again.
